newsitem.title: ESTONIA: 3 PCT OF ESS SHARES TO BE SOLD IN AUCTION.
newsitem.headline: 3 PCT OF ESS SHARES TO BE SOLD IN AUCTION.

text.p: Three percent of shares in Estonian security market leader ESS will be sold by Hoiupank Investments next Thursday in an auction, the bank said Friday.
"We will sell 30,000 shares which is a bit less than three percent of the share capital," Raul Hindov, project leader with Hoiupank Investments, told Reuters.
Hindov added that the auction would be closed and that local institutional investors will mostly participate.
The minimum price of a 10-kroon face value share is 65 kroons, Hindov added. The share price in its recent share issue was 57 kroons.
After the auction, some 33 percent of the security company's shares will be in public hands.
ESS is seeking a listing on the secondary list of the Tallinn bourse.
